scope: Every non-forced endpoint in the frozen 72-position corpus, without selecting by success. Full-information search and each side-specific interval solver have separate 1000 ms budgets; the last search chunk or solver trial may overrun and actual time is recorded. The solver uses default scheduling, 12000 live nodes, 1000 engine runs per call and a 0.005 strategy-loss target. Loss intervals fix only the first action and grant optimal continuation. Baseline actions are conditional on one recorded search seed; these are not population-policy, hidden-information or complete-game strength certificates. No production adoption.
